payload.name: Doublespeed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create social slideshows and product videos using your Doublespeed templates and media. Browse sample folders, pinned templates, and brand knowledge, then save editable drafts and share review links. Scoped to the Doublespeed products your account can access.
payload.longDescription:
使用您的Doublespeed模板和媒体创建社交媒体幻灯片和产品视频。
浏览示例文件夹、固定模板和品牌知识库，然后保存可编辑的草稿并分享评审链接。
限定为您账户可访问的Doublespeed产品。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: Tikita
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and refine interactive story drafts in Tikita. Connect your account to edit characters, episodes, variables, example dialogue, lorebook entries and image links in stories you own. Review edits and save them in Tikita Studio; publishing is a separate step.
payload.longDescription:
在Tikita中创建并完善互动故事草稿。
连接您的账户以编辑您所拥有故事中的角色、剧集、变量、示例对话、背景故事条目及图片链接。
审核修改并保存至Tikita Studio；发布为独立操作步骤。

payload.name: Vivideo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vivideo helps users create AI videos from text or images, build presenter videos, estimate generation credits, and view videos saved in their Vivideo account through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Vivideo帮助用户从文本或图像创建AI视频，制作演讲者视频，估算生成积分，并通过ChatGPT查看其Vivideo账户中保存的视频。

payload.name: Super Map World
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search more than 18,000 ready-made map graphics from Super Map World, covering over 200 countries and the world. Find flat country maps and globe views, filter by projection, colour, and borders - including administrative levels such as regions, provinces, and counties where available. Most maps are free to download and reuse with attribution under Creative Commons and other open licences.
payload.longDescription: 从Super Map World搜索超过18,000张现成的地图图形，涵盖200多个国家及世界地图。找到平面国家地图和地球视图，按投影方式、颜色和边界筛选——包括地区、省份和县区等行政层级（如适用）。大多数地图在知识共享协议和其他开放许可下可免费下载并注明来源。

payload.name: Tattoos Wizard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tattoos Wizard helps people plan a tattoo before they book. Estimate what a tattoo typically costs at studios in 618 cities by size, level of detail and colour; find real tattoo artists and studios from the Tattoos Wizard directory (10,000+) by style and city, with portfolio images and profile links; and find practical guides on aftercare, healing, pain by placement, cost and styles. No account is needed, and every tool only reads public Tattoos Wizard data.
payload.longDescription: Tattoos Wizard帮助人们在预订前规划纹身。通过尺寸、细节程度和颜色估算纹身在618个城市的典型价格；根据风格和城市查找Tattoos Wizard目录中的真实纹身艺术家和工作室（10,000+），包含作品集图片和资料链接；获取关于术后护理、愈合过程、不同部位疼痛感、价格及风格的实用指南。无需账户即可使用，所有工具仅读取公开的Tattoos Wizard数据。

payload.name: MeiGen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create and edit images and videos with MeiGen. Browse available models and workflow prices, find up to three visual inspirations, and turn a selected idea into an image or video. Remove or replace backgrounds, upscale images, create marketing posters, and generate selected product-detail images.

Connect a verified MeiGen account to use paid tools. Generations use your existing purchased credits; daily free credits do not apply. Review the current price and requested image count before starting. MeiGen does not sell credits or subscriptions through this plugin.

With your permission, prepare a selected image attachment or direct public image URL. Prepared images receive public links accessible to anyone who has the link and are scheduled for cleanup seven days after their latest upload. Accepted generations retain separate reference copies for history and reuse; contact support for removal. Storage cleanup does not guarantee immediate removal of cached copies. Uploads are not automatically published to the gallery.

Recover an existing task after a timeout without starting another generation, and revoke access from MeiGen's Connected apps page. Image previews depend on the host; original result links remain available.
payload.longDescription:
通过MeiGen创建和编辑图像和视频。浏览可用模型和工作流价格，找到最多三个视觉灵感，并将选定创意转化为图像或视频。移除或替换背景，放大图像，制作营销海报，并生成精选的产品详情图像。

连接已验证的MeiGen账户以使用付费工具。生成操作将使用您已购买的积分；每日免费积分不适用。开始前请查看当前价格和所需图像数量。MeiGen不通过此插件销售积分或订阅服务。

在获得您授权的情况下，准备选定的图像附件或公开图像URL。已准备的图像将生成可供任何人通过链接访问的公开链接，且在最新上传后七天安排清理。已接受的生成结果会保留独立参考副本用于历史记录和重复使用；如需删除请联系支持团队。存储清理不会保证立即删除缓存副本。上传内容不会自动发布到画廊。

在超时后恢复现有任务而无需启动新的生成操作，并通过MeiGen的已连接应用页面撤销访问权限。图像预览依赖于主机方设置；原始结果链接仍可访问。

payload.name: Ruwana
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ruwana Studio brings a connected creative production workflow into ChatGPT. Start from an idea, brief, product, manuscript, image, or other source material and use Ruwana tools to create professional photography, commercial visuals, fashion campaigns, lookbooks, ads, cinematic scenes, animation, avatars, motion, and video.

For fashion and commercial production, Ruwana goes beyond generating a single image. It supports consistent models and characters across shots and uses production direction such as camera, lens, lighting, proportions, styling, and product fidelity to create controlled editorial and commercial results.

For film and documentary workflows, production can begin from manuscripts, photographs, documents, or archival material and continue into visual interpretation, character and environment development, scene creation, previsualization, and moving sequences.

Photography, image creation, animation, motion, avatars, and video can belong to the same connected workflow, with one result becoming the source for the next production step. You describe what you want to create in ChatGPT, and Ruwana executes the requested production through its connected tools.
payload.longDescription:
Ruwana Studio将互联的创意制作流程引入ChatGPT。从一个创意、简报、产品、手稿、图片或其他素材出发，使用Ruwana工具创建专业摄影、商业视觉、时尚活动、造型集、广告、电影场景、动画、虚拟形象、动态效果和视频。

在时尚和商业制作领域，Ruwana超越了单张图片的生成。它支持跨镜头的一致性模型和角色塑造，并通过摄影指导（如相机参数、镜头选择、灯光设置、比例控制、造型搭配和产品真实度）实现受控的编辑与商业成果。

在电影和纪录片工作流中，可从手稿、照片、文件或档案素材开始，延续至视觉诠释、角色与环境开发、场景构建、预可视化及动态镜头序列创作。

摄影、图像创作、动画、动态效果、虚拟形象和视频可纳入同一互联工作流，前一阶段成果可直接作为下一阶段的创作素材。您在ChatGPT中描述所需创作内容，Ruwana通过互联工具执行指定的制作流程。

payload.name: Klap
payload.description: 将视频转化为爆款短视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Klap turns long videos into short vertical clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, right from ChatGPT.

Share a YouTube, Twitch, Kick or Vimeo link, or any public video URL, and ask for shorts. Klap finds the most engaging moments, reframes them to 9:16 around the speaker, adds animated captions and ranks every clip by virality score. Clipping runs in the background: a live card shows its progress, then turns into a gallery of shorts you can play right in the conversation.

From the gallery you can:
• Watch each short with its captions
• Download a short as an MP4
• Schedule a short to your connected YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn or Facebook accounts, at the time you choose
• Open a short in the Klap editor to fine-tune captions, layout and length

You can also guide the clipping ("the funniest moments about pricing", "15-second clips", "5 clips at most"), set the spoken language, and ask for your recent projects.

Using Klap in ChatGPT requires a Klap account. Exports and scheduling follow your Klap plan. Social accounts are connected on klap.app, and ChatGPT never receives their credentials. Klap only publishes a post after you confirm the short, the accounts, the time and the caption.
payload.longDescription:
Klap可直接通过ChatGPT将长视频转换为适合TikTok、Instagram Reels和YouTube Shorts的竖版短视频。

分享YouTube、Twitch、Kick或Vimeo链接，或任何公开视频URL并请求生成短视频。
Klap会找到最吸引人的片段，以演讲者为中心调整为9:16比例，添加动态字幕并按病毒传播评分对每个视频进行排序。
剪辑在后台运行：实时卡片显示进度，完成后会生成可直接在对话中播放的短视频合集。

从视频合集中可执行以下操作：
• 带字幕观看每个短视频
• 将短视频下载为MP4格式
• 自定义时间将短视频发布到已连接的YouTube、TikTok、Instagram、LinkedIn或Facebook账号
• 在Klap编辑器中打开短视频，精细调整字幕、布局和时长

您还可以指导剪辑内容（「关于定价的最好笑片段」、「15秒视频」、「最多5个视频」），设置口语语言并请求查看最近的项目。

在ChatGPT中使用Klap需要Klap账户。
导出和发布功能遵循您的Klap套餐计划。
社交账号在klap.app上连接，ChatGPT永远不会获取您的凭证。
Klap仅在您确认短视频内容、发布账号、发布时间和字幕后才会进行发布。

payload.name: Canvora
payload.description: 创建符合品牌规范的视觉内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Canvora turns your content into on-brand marketing visuals inside ChatGPT.

Share a URL, a document, text, or an idea. Canvora reads it and creates a full set of designs – social posts, carousels, stories, ads, presentations, and slide decks – in your saved brand kit (logo, colors, fonts, style). You can create for multiple brands and keep each one consistent.

What you can do:
  - Turn a URL, document, text, or idea into visuals across 100+ formats
  - Save a brand kit per brand so every visual stays on-brand
  - Localize a whole set into any of 150+ supported languages, with text regenerated natively – right-to-left and non-Latin scripts supported
  - Edit in plain language (e.g. "make the headline warmer") and regenerate with the layout intact
  - Create variations and export to PDF, PPTX, or ZIP at 2K or 4K

Built for creators, freelancers, marketing teams, and agencies – whether you run one brand or many.
payload.longDescription:
Canvora在ChatGPT内将您的内容转化为符合品牌规范的营销视觉素材。

分享一个网址、文档、文本或创意想法。
Canvora会读取内容并生成一套完整的设计——社交帖子、幻灯片、故事、广告、演示文稿和幻灯片演示——使用您保存的品牌套件（Logo、颜色、字体、风格）。
您可以为多个品牌创建内容，并保持每个品牌的视觉一致性。

您可以实现以下操作：
  - 将网址、文档、文本或创意想法转化为100多种格式的视觉内容
  - 为每个品牌保存品牌套件，确保所有视觉内容符合品牌规范
  - 将整套内容本地化为150多种支持的语言，文本可原生再生——支持从右到左和非拉丁字母脚本
  - 用自然语言编辑（例如「让标题更温暖」），并保持版式不变重新生成
  - 创建不同版本并以2K或4K分辨率导出为PDF、PPTX或ZIP格式

专为创作者、自由职业者、营销团队和代理机构设计——无论您只运营一个品牌还是多个品牌。

payload.name: QynTro AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create media from ChatGPT with the credits in your QynTro account.

• Images from FLUX, GPT Image, Nano Banana and Stability AI models
• Image editing with an instruction, including placing a logo or product from a second image
• Video from text, or from a picture you just made; video editing
• UGC spokesperson ads from one photo, lip-sync, and music videos cut to a song
• Original music tracks up to two minutes
• Voiceovers in many voices and languages
• Talking avatars: a studio presenter or your own photo speaking a script
• PowerPoint decks (.pptx) from a topic
• Textured 3D models (GLB) from a photo or a description

Everything you make is saved to your QynTro library. Sign in with your QynTro account; each generation uses credits from your existing balance, and every reply says what it cost. Tools that bring a real face to life ask you to confirm you have the right to use that face and voice.
payload.longDescription:
通过QynTro账户中的积分，从ChatGPT生成媒体内容。

• 通过FLUX、GPT Image、Nano Banana和Stability AI模型生成图像
• 根据指令进行图像编辑，包括将第二张图像中的logo或产品放置到当前图像
• 通过文字或您刚制作的图片生成视频；支持视频编辑
• 通过一张照片生成UGC代言人广告，支持唇形同步和根据歌曲剪辑的音乐视频
• 生成时长最多两分钟的原创音乐作品
• 支持多种语音和语言的旁白
• 会说话的虚拟形象：专业主播或您本人照片演绎的脚本
• 通过主题生成PowerPoint演示文稿（.pptx格式）
• 通过照片或描述生成带纹理的3D模型（GLB格式）

您创作的所有内容都会保存到QynTro资料库中。
使用QynTro账户登录；每次生成会消耗账户现有积分，每次回复都会显示具体消耗量。
那些让真实面孔栩栩如生的工具会要求您确认您有权使用该面孔和声音。

payload.name: Doitong
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Doitong is an AI video studio. Ask ChatGPT to create videos, images, music and short films, and get the results right in the conversation. Everything is saved to your Doitong library.

- Idea or photo to video: text-to-video, image-to-video, effects and current short-video trends.
- Images and posters in any aspect ratio.
- Music tracks.
- Short films with director agents: choose an agent, describe your idea, review the script, and the agent shoots it scene by scene.
- Check progress and browse your recent work.

Sign in with your existing Doitong account. Paid actions use the credits already in your account: each one shows its price and waits for your confirmation, and each connection has its own spending limit (100,000 credits by default) that you can change in Doitong settings.
payload.longDescription:
Doitong是一个AI视频工作室。
让ChatGPT帮你创建视频、图片、音乐和短片，直接在对话中获取结果。
所有内容都会保存到你的Doitong库中。

- 从创意或照片生成视频：支持文本生成视频、图片生成视频、特效及当前短视频趋势
- 任意宽高比的图片和海报
- 音乐片段
- 带导演代理的短片：选择代理角色，描述你的创意，审阅剧本，代理会逐场景拍摄
- 查看进度并浏览你的近期作品

使用现有Doitong账户登录。
付费操作将使用账户中已有的积分：每个操作会显示价格等待你确认，每个连接都有独立的消费限额（默认100,000积分）可在Doitong设置中修改。

payload.name: Cyber AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cyber AI brings the models of your Cyber AI account into the chat. Describe what you want, and the assistant picks a model, shows the exact price and starts the generation only after you agree.

What you can make:
- Images from a text description, in many styles
- Short videos from a text description
- Songs, instrumental music and voice-over
- 3D models

How it works:
1. Connect your existing Cyber AI account: sign in on cyhub.ai and choose Allow.
2. Ask for a picture, a video, music or a 3D model in plain words.
3. The assistant checks the settings with the model and shows the price. Nothing is charged at this step.
4. After you confirm, the generation starts. When it is ready, you get download links to the files.

Your money stays under your control:
- Paid generations are off for every new connection until you turn them on.
- Each connection spends only within your account limits, per generation and per day. You can change them on the Apps tab of your account.
- The price you confirmed is the most you pay. A failed generation is not charged.
- A generation that is still waiting in the queue can be cancelled, and the reserved money returns to the balance.

Generations are paid from the balance of your Cyber AI account, at the same prices as on the website and in the Cyber AI bots. A Cyber AI account is required.

Download links work for 7 days. The history of your generations stays in your account.

Works in English and Russian.
payload.longDescription:
Cyber AI将您的Cyber AI账户中的模型带入聊天对话中。描述您需要的内容，助手会选择合适的模型，显示具体价格，并在您确认后才开始生成。

您可以创建：
- 通过文字描述生成的图像，支持多种风格
- 通过文字描述生成的短视频
- 歌曲、器乐和配音
- 3D模型

使用流程：
1. 连接您的现有Cyber AI账户：访问cyhub.ai登录并选择允许
2. 用普通语言请求图片、视频、音乐或3D模型
3. 助手会检查模型设置并显示价格
此步骤不会产生费用
4. 确认后开始生成
生成完成后您将获得文件下载链接。

您的资金始终受您控制：
- 每次新连接时，付费生成功能均处于关闭状态，直到您手动开启
- 每个连接的每次生成和每日消耗均不超过您的账户限额
您可以在账户的「应用」标签页中修改这些设置
- 您确认的价格即为最高支付金额
失败的生成不会产生费用
- 队列中等待的生成可取消，预留资金将返还至余额。

生成费用从您的Cyber AI账户余额支付，价格与官网和Cyber AI机器人一致
需要拥有Cyber AI账户

下载链接有效期为7天
生成记录会保留在您的账户中

支持英语和俄语

payload.name: Storyblocks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Storyblocks stock videos, music, sound effects, and images in ChatGPT. Preview results in an interactive media carousel, inspect asset metadata and available formats, find similar content, explore categories and related search terms, and refine searches with catalog counts. Download selected assets when explicitly requested. Requires Storyblocks authentication; downloads depend on account entitlements. Each successful download-link request licenses the asset, records a download, and consumes plan quota, including repeat requests.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中搜索Storyblocks的库存视频、音乐、音效和图片。
通过交互式媒体轮播预览结果，检查素材元数据和可用格式，查找相似内容，探索分类和相关搜索关键词，并通过目录计数优化搜索。
仅在用户明确请求时下载所选素材。
需要Storyblocks认证；下载内容取决于账户权限。
每次成功请求下载链接将授权该素材，记录下载行为并消耗计划配额，包括重复请求。

payload.name: McSill Ultra 5.0
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: McSill Ultra 5.0 is a storytelling and narrative development plugin based on James McSill’s methodology. It helps users analyse, structure, develop, edit, and refine stories, manuscripts, scenes, characters, dialogue, point of view, subtext, emotional progression, tension, pacing, and reader experience. It can work with fiction, non-fiction, professional narratives, and early-stage ideas, providing practical narrative analysis and editorial guidance while preserving the author’s voice, creative intent, and final decision-making.
payload.longDescription: McSill Ultra 5.0 是一款基于詹姆斯·麦西尔方法论的故事叙述开发插件。它帮助用户分析、构建、发展、编辑和精炼故事、手稿、场景、角色、对话、视角、潜台词、情感发展、张力、节奏和读者体验。该插件适用于小说、非虚构作品、专业叙述和早期创意想法，在保留作者声音、创作意图和最终决策权的同时，提供实用的叙述分析和编辑指导。

payload.name: VoxelDraft
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VoxelDraft helps users create and refine 3D voxel models through short temporary model references, inspect their geometry, explore them in an interactive 3D preview inside ChatGPT, export OBJ/MTL or compact JSON files, and optionally save or reopen private projects in their VoxelDraft account.
payload.longDescription: VoxelDraft通过简短的临时模型参考帮助用户创建并优化3D体素模型，检查其几何结构，在ChatGPT内部的交互式3D预览中探索模型，导出OBJ/MTL或紧凑的JSON文件，并可选地在其VoxelDraft账户中保存或重新打开私有项目。

payload.name: Boy or Girl Names
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Boy or Girl Names helps you browse baby names and try the site's name tools. Search boy, girl, unique, or gender-neutral names by letter or by the start of a name, including names used in a country. Draw random names from the popular boy and girl lists. Read the Chinese gender calendar from a conception date, the calendar-month gender chart, and the Chinese zodiac for a birth date. Chart results are folklore from the public pages, not a medical test. The plugin does not store the dates you enter and does not give name meanings.
payload.longDescription: Boy or Girl Names 可帮助您浏览婴儿名字并试用网站的命名工具。按字母或名字开头搜索男孩、女孩、独特或中性名字，包括在某个国家使用的名称。从流行男孩和女孩名单中随机生成名字。查阅根据受孕日期生成的中国性别日历、按月份的性别图表以及出生日期的中国生肖。图表结果源自公共页面的民间传说，并非医疗检测。该插件不会保存您输入的日期，也不会提供名字含义。

payload.name: Create Prints
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create Prints turns images and generated artwork into physical wall prints, posters, and framed artwork. It prepares chat images for printing, shows compatible products and prices, creates secure checkout links, and tracks Create Prints orders through delivery.
payload.longDescription: Create Prints可将图像和生成的艺术作品转化为实体墙饰、海报和装裱艺术品。它可为聊天图像准备打印，展示兼容产品及价格，创建安全结账链接，并跟踪Create Prints订单的配送流程。

payload.name: Algorithmic Ink
payload.description: 将照片转化为矢量艺术
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Algorithmic Ink turns your photos into geometric artwork directly inside ChatGPT. Transform a portrait, pet photo, object or landscape into spiral FM line art, scribble drawings, circle stippling or triangle art, then preview and refine the result in an interactive studio.
Start by attaching a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo to your conversation, or choose a photo through the studio’s file picker. Describe the style you want, select ink and background colors, and adjust the drawing controls to change detail, contrast, line weight and other style-specific settings. Optional background removal isolates the subject; turn it off to preserve the complete scene.
Continue refining your artwork through conversation or the studio’s controls. For example, ask to switch from spiral lines to scribble art, make the lines thinner, or change the colors while keeping the same photo. When the artwork is ready, download an SVG for further editing in compatible design software or a PNG for convenient viewing and sharing.
Image processing and artwork generation run locally in your browser while the studio is open. Algorithmic Ink does not maintain a server-side library of your photos or finished artwork. The ChatGPT integration processes photo references and drawing settings, and shares rendering status, settings and a small artwork preview with ChatGPT to support follow-up requests. Photos selected in the studio are uploaded to ChatGPT when its upload feature is available, and exports may pass through ChatGPT’s download feature. The privacy policy explains these data flows, recipients, retention and user controls.
No separate Algorithmic Ink account is required, and Algorithmic Ink currently charges no usage fee. The app creates artwork from existing photos; it does not generate images from text alone, produce videos, or provide printing and shipping services. Processing speed and download availability depend on your device, browser and ChatGPT’s supported features.
payload.longDescription:
Algorithmic Ink可直接在ChatGPT内将照片转化为几何艺术作品。将人像、宠物照片、物体或风景转化为螺旋FM线艺术、涂鸦草图、圆形点彩或三角形艺术，然后在交互式工作室中预览并优化效果。通过对话附加JPEG/PNG/WebP格式照片，或使用工作室的文件选择器上传图片。描述期望的风格，选择墨水和背景颜色，并调整绘图控制参数以修改细节、对比度、线条粗细等特定风格设置。可选的背景移除功能可单独提取主体；关闭此功能可保留完整场景。通过对话或工作室控制持续优化作品。例如可要求将螺旋线改为涂鸦艺术、调整线条粗细，或在保持原图基础上更换颜色。作品完成后可下载SVG格式用于兼容设计软件的进一步编辑，或下载PNG格式便于查看和分享。在工作室开启期间，图像处理和艺术生成均在浏览器本地运行。Algorithmic Ink不会在服务器端保存您的照片或成品艺术作品。
ChatGPT集成模块负责处理照片参考和绘图设置，并将渲染状态、设置和小尺寸作品预览共享给ChatGPT，以支持后续请求。在工作室中选择的照片会在ChatGPT上传功能可用时上传，并且导出内容可能通过ChatGPT的下载功能传输。隐私政策详细说明了这些数据流的接收方、保留期限和用户控制方式。无需单独的Algorithmic Ink账户，且目前Algorithmic Ink不收取任何使用费用。该应用基于现有照片生成艺术作品，不单独通过文本生成图像、制作视频，也不提供印刷和物流服务。处理速度和下载可用性取决于您的设备、浏览器及ChatGPT支持的功能。

payload.name: Generate Greetings
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create thoughtful greetings for everyday moments, birthdays, anniversaries and celebrations in 13 languages, including Hindi. Get a greeting as text or make a complete card with occasion-matched backgrounds and optional decorations. Try another version and download the image, or open its reusable design on Generate Greetings to customize it.

Cards are free and include a watermark. No Generate Greetings account is needed. Optional first names personalize the response and image; reusable web links omit names and expire after 30 days. The connector does not send messages, publish social posts or make purchases.
payload.longDescription:
为日常时刻、生日、纪念日和庆典创建贴心问候语，支持13种语言，包括印地语。获取文本问候语或制作完整卡片，搭配与场合匹配的背景和可选装饰。尝试其他版本并下载图片，或在Generate Greetings上打开可重复使用的设计进行自定义。

卡片免费提供，但包含水印。无需Generate Greetings账户即可使用。可选的名字符号可个性化回复和图片；可重复使用的网页链接不显示姓名，且30天后失效。该连接器不会发送消息、发布社交动态或进行购买操作。

payload.name: Crealix
payload.description: 在聊天中创建完成的视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Crealix makes finished short-form and long-form videos from an idea or a script: faceless narrated videos, scene-by-scene videos, Reddit stories, tweet threads, text-message stories, AI dramas, AI movies, music videos and more. It picks a voice, a visual style, captions and music that suit the video from Crealix's catalog (or your saved brand), shows you a proposal to approve, and plays a draft with the voice, captions and music right in the chat. Ask for changes in plain words and render the final MP4 when you're happy. Crealix also generates images, video clips, music, avatar videos and 4K upscales, and uses your own files: attach them to the chat or upload them from the card. Everything is saved to your Crealix library and uses your Crealix credits; the cost is shown before anything is spent, and bigger spends ask for your OK.
payload.longDescription: Crealix可根据一个创意或脚本制作完成的短视频和长视频，包括无面视频、分镜头视频、Reddit故事、推文线程、短信故事、AI戏剧、AI电影、音乐视频等。它会从Crealix的目录（或您的品牌）中选择适合视频的配音、视觉风格、字幕和音乐，向您展示一个提案以供批准，并在聊天中播放带有配音、字幕和音乐的草稿。用简单明了的语言提出修改要求，并在您满意后生成最终的MP4文件。Crealix还可生成图片、视频片段、音乐、头像视频和4K超分辨率视频，并支持使用您的自有文件：将文件附加到聊天或从卡片上传。所有内容都会保存到您的Crealix资料库中，并使用您的Crealix积分；在任何支出之前会显示成本，较大的支出需要您的确认。

payload.name: UnifyAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create Videos and Images inside Chat-GPT with Unify
payload.longDescription: 通过Unify在Chat-GPT中创建视频和图像

payload.name: OceanToken
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OceanToken puts 500+ AI models behind one account and one prepaid balance: GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Qwen for text; GPT Image, Seedream, Recraft and Gemini for images; Seedance, Veo, Sora and Wan for video; plus text-to-speech and transcription.

Search the catalog by type, capability and price, see exactly which options a model accepts, and get a cost estimate before anything runs, with a check against your available balance. Then generate: images with previews, video jobs you can follow to completion, voice-overs, subtitles, or a one-shot answer from another model when a cheaper or different model fits the task better. Results come back as download links. Every request is billed to your existing OceanToken balance at catalog prices; failed video jobs are not charged, and you can set a spending cap per request.

Connect with your OceanToken email and password (a dedicated API key is created for the plugin, revocable in the OceanToken console) or with an existing API key.
payload.longDescription:
OceanToken将500+人工智能模型整合至单一账户与预付余额：文本生成支持GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek和Qwen；图像生成支持GPT Image、Seedream、Recraft和Gemini；视频生成支持Seedance、Veo、Sora和Wan；另含语音合成与语音转文字功能。

按类型、功能和价格搜索目录，查看模型具体支持哪些选项，并在执行前获取精确成本估算，系统会与您的可用余额进行校验。然后开始生成：可预览图像、跟踪视频任务至完成、制作配音、添加字幕，或当更经济或更适合的模型存在时，通过其他模型获取一次性解决方案。结果将以下载链接形式返回。每次请求将按照目录价格从您的现有OceanToken余额中扣费；失败的视频任务不会收费，您还可为单次请求设置支出上限。

使用OceanToken邮箱和密码登录（插件会生成专用API密钥，可在OceanToken控制台中撤销），或直接使用现有API密钥。

payload.name: BusbySim
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn a potential idea into a SysML v2 model you can see and develop, right in ChatGPT.

Describe a system, such as an aircraft architecture, a drone or an EV powertrain. ChatGPT drafts the SysML v2 model using BusbySim's syntax guide, then BusbySim validates the syntax. ChatGPT corrects any errors it reports until the model is valid. BusbySim then shows the model in its editor and diagram inside the chat. There you can pan, zoom and edit the SysML, and the diagram updates as you type. You can also work entirely in the diagram, using the right click to add, delete or edit elements.

To keep working on your model, open it in BusbySim as a project. You sign in or create a free account first. Within BusbySim you can link requirements, complete functional analysis, or output FHA, FMEA, fault trees and safety reports.

No login is needed in ChatGPT, and the plugin can't see your saved BusbySim projects. The syntax check covers the BusbySim specific subset of SysML v2 syntax only. It doesn't check what the model means or prove the design is safe.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中直接将潜在想法转化为可查看和开发的SysML v2模型。

描述一个系统，例如飞机架构、无人机或电动汽车动力总成。
ChatGPT会根据BusbySim的语法指南生成SysML v2模型，随后BusbySim进行语法验证。
ChatGPT根据报告的错误进行修正，直到模型有效。
然后BusbySim会在聊天窗口中显示模型编辑器和图表。
您可以在此进行平移、缩放和编辑SysML，图表会随着输入实时更新。
您也可以完全在图表中操作，通过右键菜单添加、删除或编辑元素。

要继续完善模型，请在BusbySim中以项目形式打开它。
您需要先登录或创建免费账户。
在BusbySim中您可以关联需求、完成功能分析，或输出FHA、FMEA、故障树和安全报告。

在ChatGPT中无需登录，插件也无法查看您保存的BusbySim项目。
语法检查仅覆盖BusbySim特有的SysML v2语法子集。
它不会检查模型的实际含义或证明设计是安全的。

payload.name: Inkdrop
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring an image from your conversation to a T-shirt or another available Inkdrop product. If you do not have artwork yet, create or attach a design in ChatGPT first. Once the image is ready, send “Choose my Inkdrop product” to open the picker.

Browse a horizontal product list, read details, enlarge photos, and choose available colors, sizes and print options. Apply your artwork and review the finished mockup in the conversation. Change the product or scale, recover saved choices after a reload, and open the real product preview on Inkdrop. To rework artwork, edit the standalone image in ChatGPT and explicitly continue with the finished image; review it before applying.

When ready to buy, open Inkdrop’s website to review your product, shipping, taxes and payment. Opening checkout does not place an order. US availability and prices vary. An Inkdrop account is required to save artwork and create previews. Artwork and mockup images are unlisted, but anyone with their image link can view them.
payload.longDescription:
将对话中的图片转化为T恤或其他可用的Inkdrop产品。
如果没有现成的艺术作品，请先在ChatGPT中创建或附加一个设计。
图片准备就绪后，发送“Choose my Inkdrop product”打开选择器。

浏览横向产品列表，查看详细信息，放大图片，并选择可用的颜色、尺寸和印刷选项。
应用您的艺术作品并在对话中查看最终样图。
可更换产品或调整尺寸，刷新后可恢复已保存的选择，并在Inkdrop上打开真实产品预览。
如需重新修改艺术作品，请在ChatGPT中编辑独立图片并明确继续使用完成的图片；应用前请再次确认。

准备购买时，打开Inkdrop官网查看您的产品、运费、税费和支付信息。
打开结账页面不会立即下单。
美国地区可用性和价格可能有所不同。
需要Inkdrop账户才能保存艺术作品并创建预览。
艺术作品和样图均为未公开内容，但持有图片链接的人可查看。

payload.name: Fablyn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and revise short explainer videos and slides in your Fablyn workspace. Describe what you want to explain, then use Fablyn to save a Video, check its stills, and refine the words, layout and motion. Add optional narration and render a finished video, or approve stills as slides. Review your work and manage approvals in Fablyn Studio. A Fablyn account is required. Narration and rendering use your workspace’s minutes.
payload.longDescription: 在Fablyn工作区中创建并修订简短的解释性视频和幻灯片。描述您需要解释的内容，然后使用Fablyn保存视频，检查静态画面，并优化文字、版式和动态效果。可添加可选配音并渲染完成的视频，或批准静态画面作为幻灯片。在Fablyn Studio中查看作品并管理审批流程。需要Fablyn账户。配音和渲染将消耗工作区的分钟数。

payload.name: Gradients Studio
payload.description: 网站和演示文稿的背景设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Gradients Studio designs backgrounds for the things you ship: website heroes, launch posts, OG images and slides.

Describe what it's for and how it should feel ("a dark, premium hero for a fintech landing page", "launch visuals in purple and orange, a bit retro"), or name your brand colours. You get six live variations in mesh, silk and cloud styles with real film grain, pixel and dither finishes. Pick one, adjust its colours, finish, grain and softness right in the chat, then approve it.

Once approved, Gradients Studio exports it at exactly the sizes you need: hero, OG image, X and LinkedIn posts, slides, or any custom size up to 4K. In Codex, the files go straight into your project and can be wired into the section you named.

Already designing in the studio? Use Copy for ChatGPT on any design and paste it into the chat to keep working on that exact background here.

Designing and previewing need no account. Connect your Gradients Studio account to export. Gradients Studio makes abstract gradient backgrounds only: it doesn't draw logos, illustrations or icons, and it doesn't edit photos.
payload.longDescription:
Gradients Studio为你的产品设计背景：网站首屏、发布帖、OG图片和幻灯片。

描述它用途和氛围（「为金融科技落地页设计的暗色高端首屏」「带有紫色和橙色的复古发布视觉」），或指定品牌配色。
你将获得六种实时变化的样式：网状、丝绸和云朵风格，配备真实胶片颗粒、像素和抖动效果。
选择一种样式，直接在聊天窗口调整颜色、质感、颗粒度和柔化程度，然后进行确认。

确认后，Gradients Studio会按你所需的精确尺寸导出：首屏、OG图片、X和领英帖子、幻灯片，或任何最大4K的自定义尺寸。
在Codex中，文件会直接进入你的项目，并可连接到你命名的区域。

已经在工作室设计中？
对任何设计使用ChatGPT的「复制」功能，将内容粘贴到聊天窗口即可继续在此处编辑该背景。

设计和预览无需账户。
连接你的Gradients Studio账户即可导出。
Gradients Studio仅制作抽象渐变背景：不绘制logo、插图或图标，也不编辑照片。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Design gradient backgrounds, Export web and social sizes

payload.name: ShareCube
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ShareCube turns what ChatGPT writes into a real document you can share and get feedback on.

Ask ChatGPT to draft a plan, a report, or a page, and it publishes to ShareCube as HTML or Markdown with its own URL. You choose who sees it: keep it private, share it inside your organisation, or open it to anyone with the link.

Reviewers highlight a sentence and comment on it, the way they would in a document. ChatGPT can read those comments back and revise. Every version is kept, so you can see what changed and restore an earlier one.

 It's useful when the people reviewing your work don't use ChatGPT themselves, when review comments would otherwise be scattered across a thread, and when you want the things an agent wrote to still be findable next month.

Free to start. The same documents are reachable from Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients, so you aren't locked to one assistant.
payload.longDescription:
ShareCube将ChatGPT撰写的内容转化为可分享并获取反馈的真实文档。

让ChatGPT起草一份计划、报告或页面，它会以HTML或Markdown格式发布到ShareCube，并生成独立的URL。您可以选择查看对象：保持私密、在组织内分享，或通过链接向所有人开放。

审阅者可以高亮某句话并进行评论，就像在文档中那样。ChatGPT可以读取这些评论并进行修改。每次版本都会被保存，您可以查看修改记录并恢复到早期版本。

当审阅您作品的人自己不使用ChatGPT时，当审阅意见原本会分散在多个对话中，以及当您希望AI生成的内容一个月后仍可被检索到时，这个功能特别有用。

免费开始使用。相同文档可通过Claude、Cursor和其他MCP客户端访问，因此您不会被锁定在单一助手上。

payload.name: Pretty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Design and revise PowerPoint presentations in Pretty. Turn a supplied brief, source files, or links into slides, then request changes to the presentation's title, content, and design. Use Pretty to create project updates, client reports, and business presentations.

Start a presentation in a Pretty chat or continue an existing one. The plugin sends your presentation instructions to Pretty, follows progress, and returns the chat link so you can inspect the slides and continue editing in the Pretty editor.

Use files and presentation guidance from your connected workspace as source material. When the workspace offers the relevant tools, you can use brand kits, asset libraries, and reusable slide pools to guide the presentation's design.

A Pretty account and access to a Pretty workspace are required. The connection respects the account's workspace permissions. Upload and download features depend on the tools available to that workspace. Pretty creates presentations; it does not execute payments.
payload.longDescription:
在Pretty中设计并修改PowerPoint演示文稿。
将提供的简要说明、源文件或链接转换为幻灯片，然后请求修改演示文稿的标题、内容和设计。
使用Pretty创建项目更新、客户报告和商务演示文稿。

在Pretty聊天中开始演示文稿或继续现有演示文稿。
插件会将您的演示文稿指令发送至Pretty，跟踪进度，并返回聊天链接供您查看幻灯片并继续在Pretty编辑器中编辑。

使用已连接工作区中的文件和演示指导作为素材。
当工作区提供相关工具时，您可以使用品牌套件、资产库和可重复使用的幻灯片池来指导演示文稿的设计。

需要Pretty账户和对Pretty工作区的访问权限。
连接会遵循账户的工作区权限。
上传和下载功能取决于该工作区可用的工具。
Pretty负责创建演示文稿；不处理支付操作。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create PowerPoint slides, Edit existing presentations, Use existing workspace files, Continue presentation chats, Read workspace skills, Upload and download source files

payload.name: Kittl
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate product shots, mockups, UGC videos, and listing videos. Create merchandise, branding, and marketing assets. All without leaving the chat. Kittl has a workflow built for each one, so you pick the result you want and describe your product. Everything shows up in the chat and saves to your Kittl account. Images are ready to drop onto a mockup or export print-ready. Videos are ready to post. Kittl is where people design and launch the products they sell. This puts it in your chat.
payload.longDescription:
生成产品实拍图、模板、用户生成内容视频和商品展示视频
制作商品、品牌和营销素材
无需离开聊天界面即可完成
Kittl为每种需求都设计了专属流程，您只需选择目标效果并描述产品即可
所有内容都会显示在聊天中并保存到您的Kittl账户
图片可直接放置到模板或导出印刷可用格式
视频可直接发布
Kittl是人们设计并推出所售产品的场所
这将直接融入您的聊天界面

payload.name: Spline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Spline is a design platform for interactive 3D content. Ask for an 3d scene or object and it gets built in the Spline 3D editor, which opens beside the chat so you can watch it come together, edit it or iterate with it.

Build 3d presentations, 3d simulations, 3d configurators, 3d illustrations, 3d icons, and more. The scenes you build can be edited.

Create 3d landing pages and interactive experiences, and refine your 3d creations with direct manipulation using the 3d editor. Export your content to other formats, or deploy as URLs.
payload.longDescription:
Spline是用于交互式3D内容的设计平台。您可以请求3D场景或对象，系统会通过Spline 3D编辑器进行构建，该编辑器会打开在聊天界面旁边，您可以观看其构建过程，进行编辑或迭代操作。

可创建3D演示文稿、3D模拟、3D配置器、3D插画、3D图标等，您构建的场景均可进行编辑。

可创建3D着陆页和互动体验，并通过3D编辑器进行直接操作优化3D作品。支持将内容导出为其他格式，或以URL形式部署。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create 3D scenes, Design websites and app screens, Edit Spline files, Review the scene with screenshots

payload.name: Artlist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create images, videos, music, and voiceovers with leading AI models on Artlist, right inside ChatGPT. Start with an idea, add a reference image, and turn it into ready-to-use creative, plus find licensed music in the Artlist catalog without leaving your conversation

With Artlist, you can:

• Turn one image into a full campaign. Generate launch videos, ads, social content, and product visuals.
• Create UGC and ads at scale. Generate authentic-looking product videos, reviews, walkthroughs, unboxings, tutorials, and more, with different hooks and formats ready to test.
• Create lifestyle and retail visuals. Put your product in different settings, lifestyles, and contexts. Mock up compositions, lighting, and framing.
• Create content for every market. Generate alternate visuals, voiceovers, and other assets adapted for different regions and audiences.
• Bring your creative tools together. Use Artlist alongside other MCPs, so your tools and context work together in one workflow.

Connect your Artlist account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
在Artlist上使用领先的AI模型创建图像、视频、音乐和配音内容，直接集成在ChatGPT中。

payload.name: Cadabra AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cadabra AI turns what you say in ChatGPT into finished images, videos and short films. Describe an idea in one sentence, attach a photo or a recording if you have one, and Cadabra designs it, generates it and hands back the result right in the chat.

What you can do:

- Videos: animate a photo or write a shot from scratch, with camera moves, effects and looks chosen for you or by you.
- Short films: go from one idea to a cut film with scenes, voice, music and captions.
- Voice and sound: narration, dialogue between characters, custom voices, music and sound effects.
- Characters: keep the same character across many shots.
- Finishing: lip sync, captions, translation, video upscaling and background removal.

How it works:
1. Connect your Cadabra AI account.
2. Ask for what you want in plain words. Cadabra picks the right engine and writes the craft prompt for you.
3. Before anything is made, you see exactly what will run and approve it.
4. Your result appears in the chat and is saved to your Cadabra gallery.

Cadabra AI works in English and Hebrew. Your creations stay in your own account at livinginmovie.com.

你能实现的功能：
- 图像：创建新图像或编辑自己的照片，支持在图像中添加英文和希伯来文文本。
- 视频：对照片进行动画处理或从零开始编写镜头，包含相机移动、特效和风格（由系统推荐或你自行选择）。

- 角色：在多个镜头中保持角色一致性。

工作流程：
1. 连接你的Cadabra AI账户。
2. 用日常语言描述需求。Cadabra会自动选择合适引擎并生成专业提示词。

payload.name: TTS Studio: AI Text to Speech
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TTSStudio is an AI text-to-speech generator and AI voice generator that converts user-provided written text into natural-sounding MP3 speech. It gives ChatGPT users an interactive workspace for turning scripts, articles, documents, lessons, stories, notes, and other written content into clear spoken audio without recording a voice manually. When a user asks ChatGPT to turn text into speech, TTSStudio opens the workspace with the supplied text prefilled. The user can review the source text, choose how it should sound, and start generation only when ready. The voice catalog can be browsed and filtered to find an appropriate AI voice for the language, style, audience, and use case. Users can preview voices, compare available options, and refine the delivery by adjusting emotion, speed, pitch, and volume before generating the final audio.
Each generation uses the applicable TTSStudio allowance and saves the result to the user's private audio history. The workspace can display recent completed or failed generations, replay completed speech, manage saved history items, delete a selected result, and show the download actions available for the user's plan. This makes it easier to return to previous voiceovers, review alternative versions, and keep generated audio organized.
TTSStudio focuses specifically on text-to-speech generation from text supplied by the user. By keeping text review, AI voice selection, speech customization, generation, playback, history, and downloads in one workflow, TTSStudio helps users convert written ideas into reusable spoken audio directly from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:

用户可查看原始文本，选择其发音方式，并在准备就绪后启动生成。
可通过浏览和筛选语音库，为语言、风格、目标受众和使用场景寻找合适的AI语音。
用户可预听语音、对比可用选项，并通过调整情感、语速、音调和音量来优化发音，再生成最终音频。
每次生成会使用相应的TTSStudio配额，并将结果保存至用户的私人音频历史记录。
工作区可显示最近完成或失败的生成记录，回放已完成的语音，管理保存的历史条目，删除选定结果，并展示用户计划对应的下载操作。
这使用户更容易返回之前的语音解说，查看替代版本，并保持生成的音频有序。
TTSStudio专门针对用户提供的文本进行文本转语音生成。
通过将文本审核、AI语音选择、语音定制、生成、播放、历史记录和下载整合到一个工作流中，TTSStudio帮助用户直接通过ChatGPT将书面想法转换为可重复使用的语音音频。

payload.name: Kids Book Maker

- A picture book in your family’s language
- A playful adventure featuring pictures you provide

Books normally have 8 to 12 pages, including the cover, and use a wide landscape format. Illustrations use the cover as a reference to help keep characters consistent, though generated pictures can vary between pages.

Books are created as unlisted, with a claim link. They are not publicly listed, but anyone with the link can watch and claim an unclaimed book to their Scrimba profile. To make a book private, sign in, claim it, and change its privacy setting to Private.

payload.name: QuickStage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Add virtual furniture and decor to real-estate listing photos. Choose a furnishing style and retrieve a preview and downloadable result in supported hosts. QuickStage works from a photo of the real space; it does not create a room from text alone. Supported exterior photos use Curb Appeal.

Start with an empty room for the best results. Furnished photos can still be staged, but existing furnishings may change. Before generation, review the selected photo, room type, style and one-credit use with your agent. Separate angles can produce different furniture.

Photos staged on the website receive corrections there.

Compare each generated image with the original and disclose virtual staging as required by your listing rules. QuickStage does not guarantee perfect image accuracy, certify MLS compliance or publish listings.

payload.name: SuperCool

When a tool can do the job, the plugin gives you a TrackGleam link that opens with a suggested starting style: free automatic mastering with WAV and MP3 downloads, a vocal-over-a-beat mixer, a Spotify Canvas maker, a music visualizer for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, a cover art maker and release-check tools. TrackGleam processes your audio in your own browser; your song is not uploaded. The plugin does not master or export files inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: TrackGleam帮助音乐人、制作人、播客创作者和AI音乐创作者完成歌曲制作并进行发布。上传一首曲目或其数据，即可获得用通俗英语解析的诊断报告，揭示歌曲存在的问题——如响度与流媒体音量的对比、削波现象、低中频浑浊、高频刺耳、立体声问题等，并提供针对Spotify、Apple Music、YouTube和TikTok的实际优化目标。当工具能完成任务时，插件会为你生成TrackGleam链接，直接打开后可选择以下功能：免费自动母带处理（支持WAV和MP3下载）、人声配节奏混音器、Spotify Canvas制作器、适用于Reels/TikTok/ Shorts的音乐可视化工具、封面艺术生成器以及发布检测工具。TrackGleam在你的浏览器中处理音频数据；你的歌曲不会被上传。该插件不会在ChatGPT内部进行母带处理或文件导出。

payload.name: AppScreenshotStudio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots for your app. Describe what the app does and AppScreenshotStudio designs a full set of store screenshots at the exact sizes Apple and Google require. Refine the set by describing the change: shorter headlines, a new colour palette, a different layout, a tilted device, or one background stretched across several screenshots. When it looks right, export the PNGs, ready to upload to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.
payload.longDescription: 为您的应用创建应用商店和Google Play截图。描述应用功能，AppScreenshotStudio将按照苹果和谷歌要求的精确尺寸设计一套完整的应用商店截图。通过描述修改内容来优化截图集：更短的标题、新的配色方案、不同的布局、倾斜的设备角度，或单一背景跨多张截图延伸。确认无误后，导出PNG格式文件，即可上传至App Store Connect或Google Play Console。

payload.name: SlidesAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SlidesAI is an AI presentation maker for creating work, business and school presentations. Turn an idea, your notes or an uploaded document into a polished presentation without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can make:
• Pitch decks for startups, products and fundraising
• Simple, clear lessons for teachers and students
• Reports, team updates and project plans
• Flowcharts, process maps and other complex diagrams
• Data slides with charts and tables
• Branded decks created from a PPTX you've imported into SlidesAI

Every slide stays editable. Fine-tune text, layout and design in the SlidesAI editor, then export your presentation to PowerPoint (PPTX), Google Slides or PDF.

SlidesAI designs the slides, saves them to your account and gives you a link to open the deck in the SlidesAI editor.
payload.longDescription:
SlidesAI是一款AI演示文稿制作工具，可用于创建工作、商业和学校演示文稿。将一个想法、您的笔记或上传的文档转化为精美的演示文稿，而无需离开ChatGPT

您可以制作：
• 初创企业、产品和融资用的路演演示文稿
• 适用于教师和学生的简洁清晰课程课件
• 报告、团队更新和项目计划
• 流程图、流程图和其他复杂图表
• 包含图表和表格的数据幻灯片
• 通过导入PPTX文件创建的品牌化演示文稿

每张幻灯片均可编辑。在SlidesAI编辑器中微调文本、版式和设计，然后将演示文稿导出为PowerPoint（PPTX）、Google Slides或PDF格式

SlidesAI会设计幻灯片，将其保存到您的账户，并提供一个链接以便在SlidesAI编辑器中打开该演示文稿

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create pitch decks, lessons and reports, Create branded decks from your imported PPTX, Turn uploaded documents into slides, Diagrams, charts, tables and AI images, Add slides to an existing presentation, Export to PPTX, Google Slides or PDF

payload.name: CutPro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CutPro finds the best moments of a long video and turns them into short, captioned vertical clips ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

Paste a YouTube, Twitch, Kick or TikTok link and CutPro clips the video, ranks the clips by how engaging they are, applies your saved templates, renders the final MP4s and posts them to the accounts you connected on cut.pro, now or on a schedule. ChatGPT always asks before starting a job or publishing anything.

It also follows your favorite channels: CutPro clips a live stream while it airs, every 10 minutes, so the best moments are ready before the broadcast ends. And it transcribes audio and video into timed captions in SRT, VTT or plain text.

Everything happens in your own CutPro workspace, the same one you use on cut.pro.
payload.longDescription:
CutPro会找出长视频中的精彩片段，将其制作成适合TikTok、Reels和Shorts的带字幕竖版短视频

粘贴YouTube、Twitch、Kick或TikTok链接后，CutPro会自动剪辑视频，根据吸引力排序片段，应用您保存的模板，生成最终MP4文件，并发布到您在cut.pro上连接的账号，支持立即发布或定时发布。
ChatGPT在开始任务或发布内容前会先询问确认。

它还会跟踪您关注的频道：CutPro会在直播进行时每10分钟剪辑一次，确保最佳片段在直播结束前就已准备就绪。
同时可将音视频内容转录为带时间戳的字幕，支持SRT、VTT或纯文本格式。

所有操作都在您专属的CutPro工作区完成，与您在cut.pro上使用的界面相同。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Clip long videos into short vertical clips, Clip live streams while they air, Apply your saved editing templates, Render clips to MP4 and share download links, Post clips to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, Transcribe audio and video into captions

payload.name: varg.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Generate images, video, voiceover and music from text prompts and reference files, using the generation models available in your varg.ai account. Find a voice preset and generate speech, browse and render published video templates, or render your own multi-scene video with captions and voiceover.

Video and render jobs run in the background: you can check their status and view the result when they finish. Generated and uploaded files are saved to your varg.ai library, and you can check your credit balance, spend and job history. Generations use credits from your varg.ai account.
payload.longDescription:
通过文本提示和参考文件生成图像、视频、配音和音乐，使用您varg.ai账户中可用的生成模型。选择语音预设生成语音，浏览并渲染已发布的视频模板，或使用字幕和配音功能渲染您自己的多场景视频。

视频和渲染任务在后台运行：您可以查看其状态并在完成后查看结果。生成和上传的文件将保存到您的varg.ai资料库，您可以查看信用额度、消费记录和任务历史。生成内容将消耗您varg.ai账户中的信用额度。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate images, Generate video, Generate voiceover and music, Render templates and multi-scene ads, Upload and manage media files, Check balance and spend

payload.name: UlazAI Media
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UlazAI Media helps users choose a supported image model, prepare a private 1K image request, create it from a recurring sponsored allowance, and retrieve the completed private file.
payload.longDescription: UlazAI Media帮助用户选择受支持的图像模型，准备私有1K图像请求，通过定期赞助额度生成，并获取完成的私有文件。

payload.name: Outfit Preview
payload.description: 在您的照片上预览服装
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Preview an attached garment on an attached person photo. Compare the original and result inline with fullscreen, Open and Download. This is a visual concept; it cannot determine body measurements, sizing or fit. A connected Firemoon account is required.
payload.longDescription: 在附加的人物照片上预览附加的服装。通过全屏、打开和下载功能直接比较原始图像和结果。这是一个视觉概念；它无法确定身体尺寸、尺码或贴合度。需要连接Firemoon账户。

payload.name: Shorts Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create 15-second videos from a brief or up to four selected still images. Preview settings and confirm generation, track progress, adjust captions, opening text, end cards, visual look and music, and download finished MP4s. For creators preparing short video content. Requires a connected Shorts Generator account with video-generation access.
payload.longDescription: 从简短描述或最多四张选定的静态图片生成15秒视频。预览设置并确认生成，跟踪进度，调整字幕、开头文字、结束卡片、视觉风格和音乐，下载完成的MP4文件。面向准备短视频内容的创作者。需要连接具备视频生成权限的Shorts Generator账户。

payload.name: NOLGIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create images, video, voiceover and edits with guided presets and your own media. Browse a visual preset gallery, filter by image or video, and open a preset to see examples, estimated cost and the questions it needs answered.

Custom widgets keep the workflow inside ChatGPT: fill in text fields, choose options, and select reference images from your NOLGIA library. Search and filter your saved assets in a visual grid, then reuse a logo, product photo or clip in your next creation.

Remake a clip you already have with Miroge. Keep its movement and give it a new subject, swap one person or product for another, or move the whole scene into a new world, then compare the remake with your original.

Turn one steady take into every camera angle with Multicam. See which angles your clip can have before anything is made, render only the ones you pick, in sync over the original sound, and get a highlight edit that cuts between them.

Choose a preset for a YouTube thumbnail, product demo, logo reveal, animation and more, or describe a task directly. Generate supported media, check video job progress, retrieve finished files, and organize assets with projects and tags. Cut short vertical clips from a longer video, make a 3D model from product photos, or edit one image step by step and go back to any earlier version. Some multi-shot productions return a brief for NOLGIA Agent and, where supported, a single preview scene rather than a completed production.

A NOLGIA account is required. Browsing presets and your library is free; generation uses NOLGIA credits.
payload.longDescription:
通过引导预设和自有媒体创建图像、视频、配音及编辑内容。浏览视觉预设图库，按图像或视频筛选，打开预设查看示例、预估成本以及需要回答的问题。

自定义组件将工作流保留在ChatGPT内：填写文本字段、选择选项，并从您的NOLGIA库中选取参考图像。在视觉网格中搜索和筛选已保存的素材，然后在下一次创作中重复使用logo、产品照片或片段。

通过Miroge重新制作已有片段。保留原有动态并赋予新主题，替换其中的人员或产品，或把整个场景迁移至新世界，然后将重制版本与原版进行对比。

通过Multicam将单个稳定镜头转化为所有摄像机角度。在制作任何内容前查看片段可能拥有的角度，仅渲染您选择的角度，同步原始音频，并生成可在不同角度间切换的精彩片段剪辑。

选择适用于YouTube缩略图、产品演示、logo揭示、动画等的预设，或直接描述任务。生成支持的媒体内容，查看视频任务进度，获取完成文件，并通过项目和标签管理素材。从长视频中剪辑短竖版片段，通过产品照片制作3D模型，或分步骤编辑单张图片并返回任何早期版本。部分多镜头制作会为NOLGIA Agent生成简报，在支持的场景中则提供单个预览场景而非完整作品。

需要NOLGIA账户。浏览预设和库内容免费；生成内容使用NOLGIA积分。

payload.name: PrintNexus Toolbox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PrintNexus Toolbox brings 3D printing tools into ChatGPT for makers and 3D printing enthusiasts.

With Lithophane Maker, turn an image into a flat lithophane: a thin 3D printed plate that reveals the image when light shines through it. Set the width in millimeters, inspect the model in an interactive 3D preview, and compare lit and backlit views. Download your model as an STL or 3MF file.

The current release supports flat lithophanes printed in one color. More 3D printing tools are planned for future updates.
payload.longDescription:
PrintNexus工具箱将3D打印工具带入ChatGPT，服务于创作者和3D打印爱好者。

通过Lithophane Maker功能，可将图像转换为扁平浮雕：一种薄型3D打印板，当光线穿透时会显现图像。
设置宽度（毫米），在交互式3D预览中检查模型，并对比光照和背光视图。
将模型下载为STL或3MF文件。

当前版本仅支持单色扁平浮雕打印。
更多3D打印工具计划在后续更新中推出。

payload.name: HyeAn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HyeAn searches the connected user's image and game-asset library from a natural-language description. Empty libraries use clearly labeled shared demo samples. Users can inspect their account plan, quota, and index status.
payload.longDescription: HyeAn通过自然语言描述搜索用户连接的图像和游戏素材库。空库会使用清晰标注的共享演示样本。用户可以查看其账户计划、配额和索引状态。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search image assets, View account quota

payload.name: Segmind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate images, audio, and video directly with Segmind. Turn your ideas into high-quality creative content using a range of generative AI models, all from one place. Whether you’re creating visuals, producing audio, or experimenting with video, Segmind makes it easy to go from a simple prompt to a finished result.
payload.longDescription:
通过Segmind直接生成图像、音频和视频。
使用一系列生成式AI模型，将您的创意转化为高质量的原创内容，所有功能尽在一处。
无论您是创作视觉内容、制作音频还是探索视频制作，Segmind都能让您轻松地将简单提示转化为最终成果。

payload.name: Alpenmarketing Bildkompressor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Komprimiere ein hochgeladenes PNG-, JPG-, WebP- oder AVIF-Bild für E-Mail, Website oder Messenger. Das Plugin verarbeitet die Datei während des Aufrufs, gibt das optimierte Bild und die Größenänderung zurück. Qualität und Ausgabeformat können gewählt werden. Dateien bis 8 MB; das Ergebnis wird nicht dauerhaft bei Alpenmarketing gespeichert.
payload.longDescription: 在调用时压缩已上传的PNG、JPG、WebP或AVIF图片，用于电子邮件、网站或即时通讯工具。插件在调用时处理文件，返回优化后的图片和尺寸调整结果。可选择质量等级和输出格式。支持最大8MB的文件；结果不会在Alpenmarketing长期保存。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Bilddateien im Chat komprimieren, PNG, JPG, WebP und AVIF als Eingabe, Größenersparnis ausweisen

payload.name: Stickers.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn a design into real stickers without leaving the conversation. Find the right sticker type, choose size, material and quantity, and see the price from stickers.com. Share or generate an image and it is attached to your order automatically, with a check that it will print sharply at the size you picked. When you're ready, check out securely on stickers.com.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开对话即可将设计转化为实际贴纸。选择合适的贴纸类型，确定尺寸、材质和数量，即可查看Stickers.com的价格。分享或生成图片后，系统会自动将其附加到订单中，并确认所选尺寸下打印效果是否清晰。确认无误后，可在Stickers.com上安全结账。

payload.name: Alpenmarketing QR-Code
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Erzeuge einen echten QR-Code als PNG für eine Webadresse, Text, E-Mail-Adresse, Telefonnummer, SMS oder WhatsApp. Das Bild wird direkt im Chat erzeugt und kann für Flyer, Speisekarten oder Einladungen verwendet werden. Vor dem Druck mit mehreren Geräten testen.
payload.longDescription:
为网址、文本、电子邮件地址、电话号码、短信或WhatsApp生成真正的PNG格式二维码。
图片会直接在聊天中生成，可用于传单、菜单或邀请函。
打印前请使用多个设备进行测试。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: QR-Code als PNG erzeugen, Links und Kontaktdaten codieren, Farben für den QR-Code wählen

payload.name: WFI — WhatFontIs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Identify fonts from screenshots and images with WhatFontIs. Compare matching fonts, preview uppercase letters, lowercase letters and numbers, and open font information pages. Results include available source and license-category information. Matches are suggestions, not a guarantee of the original font.
payload.longDescription:
通过WhatFontIs识别截图和图片中的字体。
对比匹配字体，预览大写字母、小写字母和数字，打开字体信息页面。
结果包含可用来源和许可类别信息。
匹配结果仅为建议，不保证与原始字体完全一致。

payload.name: Misar.Blog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Misar.Blog lets you write, publish and grow a blog from ChatGPT. Draft and edit articles, publish now or schedule for later, organise posts into series, research topics, generate SEO-friendly titles and cover images, and review comments, reactions, newsletter subscribers and traffic.

It is built for writers, creators and teams who publish on Misar.Blog. A Misar.Blog account is required, and the plugin only changes articles owned by the signed-in account.
payload.longDescription:
Misar.Blog让你能够通过ChatGPT撰写、发布并扩展你的博客。可草拟编辑文章，立即发布或预约后续发布，将文章整理成系列专题，进行主题调研，生成SEO优化的标题和封面图片，并查看评论、互动数据、通讯订阅者和访问流量情况。

本插件专为在Misar.Blog发布内容的创作者、内容创作者及团队设计。需要拥有Misar.Blog账户，且该插件仅对已登录账户所拥有的文章进行修改。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Write articles, Publish posts, Manage series, Research topics, Track analytics

payload.name: Remote Desktop Commander
payload.description: 通过聊天控制您的电脑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reach an authorized computer's filesystem and terminal from ChatGPT through Desktop Commander's Remote MCP. The app relays a secure connection to a machine the user controls so ChatGPT can inspect files, run commands, manage processes, edit local documents, and automate development workflows from chat. Users stay in control of which devices are connected and can disconnect them at any time.
payload.longDescription: 通过Desktop Commander的远程MCP，从ChatGPT访问授权电脑的文件系统和终端。该应用将安全连接中继到用户所控制的机器，使ChatGPT能够从聊天中检查文件、运行命令、管理进程、编辑本地文档并自动化开发流程。用户始终掌控哪些设备已连接，并可随时断开连接。

payload.name: GitHub
payload.description: 处理 PR、议题、CI 和发布流程
payload.summaryOriginal: Triage PRs, issues, CI, and publish flows
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access repositories, issues, and pull requests. Required for some features such as Codex
payload.longDescription: 访问代码仓库、议题和拉取请求。Codex 等部分功能需要此连接器

payload.name: Supabase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage Supabase projects directly through ChatGPT. Execute SQL queries on PostgreSQL databases, design and modify table schemas, deploy serverless edge functions, and configure user authentication. Access real-time logs for debugging, create and apply database migrations, and manage development branches through natural language.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 管理 Supabase 项目。在 PostgreSQL 数据库上执行 SQL 查询，设计和修改表结构，部署无服务器边缘函数，并配置用户身份认证。获取实时日志以进行调试，创建并应用数据库迁移，以及通过自然语言管理开发分支。

payload.name: Exa
payload.description: 面向 AI 智能体的网页搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Exa is the search engine for AI. Use Exa to search the web and data sources for code samples, docs, financial data, recent news, companies, people, research papers, and more. Exa is a token-efficient way to search the web.
payload.longDescription: Exa 是面向 AI 的搜索引擎。使用 Exa 在网页和数据源中搜索代码示例、文档、财务数据、最新新闻、企业、人员、研究论文等。Exa 是一种节省 token 的网页搜索方式。

payload.name: WPVibe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WPVibe connects ChatGPT to self-hosted WordPress sites so users can manage content, inspect plugins and themes, upload media, run safe WordPress admin commands, use plugin abilities, and build draft themes through conversation. It includes tested WordPress skills and playbooks for Gutenberg, Elementor, SeedProd, classic themes, editable fields, design, and SEO audits, plus one-click authorization, permission-checked tools, and draft-preview-publish workflows so changes are visible and reviewable before risky actions.
payload.longDescription: WPVibe 将 ChatGPT 连接至自行托管的 WordPress 网站，让用户通过对话管理内容、检查插件和主题、上传媒体、执行安全的 WordPress 管理命令、使用插件能力，以及构建主题草稿。它包含经过测试的 WordPress 技能和操作指南，涵盖 Gutenberg、Elementor、SeedProd、经典主题、可编辑字段、设计及 SEO 审计；还提供一键授权、经过权限检查的工具，以及草稿—预览—发布工作流，让用户在执行有风险的操作前能够查看和审核变更。

payload.name: Render
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Render helps users inspect services, deploys, logs, and metrics; create services and data stores; query Render Postgres databases; trigger deployments; and manage environment variables through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Vercel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and deploy web apps and agents
payload.longDescription: 构建并部署 Web 应用和智能体

payload.name: Parallel Search
payload.description: 面向 AI 的网页搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parallel Search provides drop-in web search and content extraction capabilities. The tools invoke the Search API and Extract API endpoints and ensure effective use by agents. Find content on the web without wasting tokens.
payload.longDescription: Parallel Search 提供可直接接入的网页搜索与内容提取能力。工具调用 Search API 和 Extract API 端点，确保智能体有效使用。在网上查找内容，避免浪费 token。

payload.name: Railway
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Railway from ChatGPT with the Railway App and Railway Skills. Create and launch apps, understand how they’re performing, manage your projects, and troubleshoot issues.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Railway App 和 Railway Skills，在 ChatGPT 中使用 Railway。创建并上线应用，了解运行表现，管理项目，并排查问题。

payload.name: Floot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and host full-stack apps using your own ChatGPT subscription. No AI build credits required. Floot MCP Server exposes the entire platform as native ChatGPT tool calls: create a project, write code, provision a database, enable auth, manage file storage, and deploy, all from a single conversation. Your ChatGPT subscription does the building. Floot handles the infrastructure. One conversation in, one working, hosted app out.
payload.longDescription: 使用你自己的 ChatGPT 订阅构建和托管全栈应用。无需 AI 构建额度。Floot MCP Server 将整个平台开放为 ChatGPT 原生工具调用：在单次对话中创建项目、编写代码、配置数据库、启用身份验证、管理文件存储并部署。你的 ChatGPT 订阅负责构建，Floot 负责基础设施。输入一次对话，产出一个可运行、已托管的应用。

payload.name: AppDeploy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AppDeploy helps users build and publish web apps from ChatGPT, monitor deployment and QA results, manage versions and source snapshots, add backend secrets, and configure custom domains.
payload.longDescription: AppDeploy 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 构建和发布网页应用，监控部署与 QA 结果，管理版本和源代码快照，添加后端密钥，并配置自定义域名。

payload.name: Stack Overflow For Agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stack Overflow For Agents provides free, trusted, production-tested knowledge, so your agents spend less time and fewer tokens rediscovering answers.  Agents can view, reply to, upvote, and verify posts created by other agents.  Is your agent stuck on a technical problem?  It can ask a question on Stack Overflow For Agents and see if other agents can solve the problem.
payload.longDescription: Stack Overflow For Agents 提供免费、可信且经生产环境验证的知识，帮助智能体减少重复寻找答案所花的时间和 token。智能体可以查看、回复、点赞并验证其他智能体创建的帖子。如果智能体遇到技术问题，可以在 Stack Overflow For Agents 上提问，看看其他智能体能否解决。

payload.name: ClickHouse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ClickHouse plugin helps users inspect ClickHouse Cloud organizations, services, databases, tables, backups, ClickPipes, billing costs, and Managed Postgres diagnostics, and run read-only SQL queries.
payload.longDescription: ClickHouse 插件帮助用户查看 ClickHouse Cloud 组织、服务、数据库、表、备份、ClickPipes、账单费用和 Managed Postgres 诊断信息，并运行只读 SQL 查询。

payload.name: GSC Wizard
payload.description: 分析 Google 搜索数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back. Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow. It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.
payload.longDescription: GSC Wizard 将 ChatGPT 连接到你自己的 Google Search Console 资源，让你用日常语言分析 SEO 表现。你可以索要表现汇总、热门查询和页面、两个时期之间的排名变化、内容衰退、关键词内耗、点击率与排名曲线或完整 SEO 报告，并获得完整答案。所有分析都在服务器端基于数据仓库计算，避免向模型传入数千行原始数据，让结果快速、准确且节省 token。你还可以列出并查看资源、运行 Google 的网址检查、追踪索引收录、管理主题集群和内容分组，并向 IndexNow 提交 URL。它还能就你已关联的 Google Analytics 4 资源提供报告，包括流量概览、维度拆分、电商、关键事件（转化）、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 等 AI 助手引荐的流量，以及合并 Search Console 与 GA4 数据的着陆页视图。汇总工具直接在 ChatGPT 中呈现交互式卡片和表格。所有访问均通过 Google 登录限定在你自己的账户范围内。

payload.name: Lovable
payload.description: 通过聊天构建全栈应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language. Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build. Follow-up messages refine the app, and you can inspect the generated code and diffs, add a PostgreSQL database and third-party connectors, manage reusable project knowledge and skills, and publish the finished app to a public URL.
payload.longDescription: Lovable 根据自然语言构建和编辑全栈 Web 应用。描述一个应用，Lovable 就会创建项目、编写 TypeScript、Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui 代码，并返回实时预览，让你看到构建过程。通过后续消息可以进一步完善应用；你还可以查看生成的代码和差异，添加 PostgreSQL 数据库及第三方连接器，管理可复用的项目知识和技能，并将完成的应用发布到公开 URL。

payload.name: TinyFish
payload.description: 查找并完成 Web 任务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TinyFish helps ChatGPT answer web questions and complete user-directed browser workflows. It can search the web, read specific pages, and run a live browser session for tasks that require interaction, such as navigating a site, clicking, filling forms, checking page state, or working inside a web app. Use it for specific requested tasks; it is not for broad crawling, bulk URL processing, or unspecified third-party access.
payload.longDescription: TinyFish 帮助 ChatGPT 回答网络问题，并完成由用户指定的浏览器工作流。它可以搜索网络、读取特定页面，并为需要交互的任务运行实时浏览器会话，例如浏览网站、点击、填写表单、检查页面状态或在 Web 应用中操作。请将其用于具体请求的任务；它不适用于广泛爬取、批量处理 URL 或未经明确指定的第三方访问。
